name.zh: 15 号联邦公路（墨西哥城—诺加莱斯）

aka.en: West Coast Highway, or Pacific Highway, in mid-century American guides
aka.zh: 二十世纪中叶美国旅行指南中的「西海岸公路」或「太平洋公路」

tagline.en: Mexico City to the Arizona border by way of Guadalajara, Tepic and the Sinaloa farm belt, finished in the early 1950s — the sources differ on the year
tagline.zh: 从墨西哥城经瓜达拉哈拉、特皮克和锡那罗亚农业带直抵亚利桑那边境，建成于 1950 年代初——具体年份各方说法不一

start.en: The Nogales port of entry at the United States border in Heroica Nogales, Sonora, where the road continues north as Interstate 19 Business
start.zh: 索诺拉州埃罗伊卡诺加莱斯的美墨边境口岸，道路由此向北接 19 号州际公路商业线

end.en: Cuajimalpa de Morelos, the western borough of Mexico City, near San Lorenzo Acopilco and the junction with Federal Highway 57D
end.zh: 墨西哥城西部的夸希马尔帕区，邻近圣洛伦索阿科皮尔科及与 57D 号联邦公路的交会处

en: Federal Highway 15 is the toll-free trunk road of Mexico's north-west. From the Nogales crossing it runs south through Hermosillo, Guaymas, Ciudad Obregón and Navojoa in Sonora, Los Mochis, Culiacán and Mazatlán in Sinaloa, and Tepic in Nayarit, then turns inland through Tequila to Guadalajara, along the southern shore of Lake Chapala, through Zamora and the historic centre of Morelia, and over the mountains to Toluca and Mexico City.

Spanish Wikipedia gives 2,378 km across seven federal entities: 697 km in Sonora, 641 in Sinaloa, 254 in Nayarit, 240 in Jalisco, 426 in Michoacán, 106 in the State of Mexico and the last 14 km in Mexico City. English Wikipedia, citing the transport ministry's 2011 road data, gives 2,363.51 km.

For much of its length it is shadowed by Federal Highway 15D, the tolled road: from Nogales to Mazatlán, and again from Villa Unión through Tepic towards Guadalajara, where most long-distance traffic takes the toll road and the free road narrows to two lanes. The government's 2025–2030 road programme counts the whole corridor, 'México–Nogales with a branch to Tijuana', as the first of its fifteen trunk axes.
zh: 15 号联邦公路是墨西哥西北部的免费干线公路。它从诺加莱斯口岸南下，经索诺拉州的埃莫西约、瓜伊马斯、奥夫雷贡城和纳沃霍阿，锡那罗亚州的洛斯莫奇斯、库利亚坎和马萨特兰，以及纳亚里特州的特皮克，随后转向内陆，经特基拉到达瓜达拉哈拉，沿查帕拉湖南岸前行，穿过萨莫拉和莫雷利亚历史城区，再翻山抵达托卢卡和墨西哥城。
西班牙语维基百科给出的长度为 2,378 公里，途经七个联邦实体：索诺拉 697 公里、锡那罗亚 641 公里、纳亚里特 254 公里、哈利斯科 240 公里、米却肯 426 公里、墨西哥州 106 公里，最后 14 公里位于墨西哥城。英语维基百科引用交通部 2011 年道路数据，给出 2,363.51 公里。
这条路的大部分路段都有收费公路 15D 号联邦公路与之并行：从诺加莱斯到马萨特兰一段，以及从比亚乌尼翁经特皮克通往瓜达拉哈拉一段——在后一段，长途车流大多走收费公路，免费公路则收窄为双车道。政府的 2025—2030 年公路计划把整条走廊「墨西哥—诺加莱斯（含通往蒂华纳的支线）」列为十五条干线轴线中的第一条。

en: The southern half came first. When Arizona Highways described the route in November 1939, the road from Mexico City to Guadalajara was already paved, and the west coast was still mostly a railway journey: cars could travel in comfort only as far as Guaymas, the governor of Sonora, Román Yocupicio, had promised to have the Nogales–Guaymas road oiled by the end of 1940, and about 500 men were working between Guadalajara and the Nayarit boundary. The magazine credited the governors of Sonora and Sinaloa with cutting other items in their budgets to pay for road building.

The hardest ground was the barrancas north and south of Tepic, the ravines between Nayarit and Jalisco. A local history of Nogales records that the narrow road out of the city was asphalted in 1942 and called International Highway number 15. Writing in 1957, William M. Bryan dated the main effort from 1946, when construction began from Guadalajara towards Nogales, to its completion in 1954. A 1999 study by Daniel D. Arreola and Kenneth D. Madsen says the highway was paved between Sinaloa and Nogales in 1950 to move produce to the United States. Spanish Wikipedia, citing President Miguel Alemán Valdés's government report, says it was finished on 1 September 1952. In October 1955 Arizona Highways still wrote that the Nogales–Guadalajara stretch had been brought up to an easy motoring standard 'only in the past year or so'.

The road opened the north-west to the rest of the country. A history of Nayarit names it as the decisive factor in the state's transformation after 1945, and the sociologist Ovidio González Gómez called Tepic–Nogales perhaps the most important road segment of the 1940s, carrying freight between Mexico City and the American west coast and supporting the intensive agriculture of Sinaloa and Sonora. Through Nogales, traffic into the interior nearly doubled between 1954 and 1959.
zh: 南半段先建成。1939 年 11 月《亚利桑那公路》杂志介绍这条线路时，墨西哥城至瓜达拉哈拉的道路已经铺装，而西海岸的旅程仍主要依靠铁路：汽车只能舒适地开到瓜伊马斯；索诺拉州州长罗曼·约库皮西奥承诺在 1940 年底前给诺加莱斯—瓜伊马斯公路铺上油面；瓜达拉哈拉至纳亚里特州界之间约有 500 人在施工。杂志称，索诺拉和锡那罗亚两州州长削减了预算中的其他项目，以支付修路费用。

最难修的是特皮克南北两侧的「巴兰卡」峡谷地带，即纳亚里特与哈利斯科之间的深谷。一部诺加莱斯地方史记载，出城的狭窄道路于 1942 年铺上沥青，并被称为 15 号国际公路。威廉·M·布赖恩在 1957 年写道，主体工程始于 1946 年，从瓜达拉哈拉向诺加莱斯修建，1954 年完工。丹尼尔·D·阿雷奥拉与肯尼思·D·马德森 1999 年的研究称，为便于向美国运送农产品，锡那罗亚至诺加莱斯一段于 1950 年铺装。西班牙语维基百科援引米格尔·阿莱曼·巴尔德斯总统的政府报告，称全线于 1952 年 9 月 1 日完工。而 1955 年 10 月，《亚利桑那公路》仍写道，诺加莱斯至瓜达拉哈拉一段「直到最近一年左右」才达到便于驾车的标准。
这条路把西北部与全国连了起来。一部纳亚里特州史称它是该州 1945 年后发生巨变的决定性因素；社会学家奥维迪奥·冈萨雷斯·戈麦斯认为，特皮克—诺加莱斯段或许是 1940 年代最重要的公路，它承担墨西哥城与美国西海岸之间的货运，并支撑了锡那罗亚和索诺拉的集约农业。经诺加莱斯进入墨西哥内地的人数在 1954 至 1959 年间几乎翻了一番。

en: The barrancas between Tepic and the Jalisco border were the engineering problem of the whole route. The Southern Pacific railway, which crossed the same country between 1923 and 1927, had needed 14 high bridges and 31 tunnels there. The highway climbs from the Santiago river into forested mountains before descending into Tepic, and further east the free road crosses south of the Ceboruco volcano, part of it directly over the volcanic field, while the newer toll road passes to the north.

In Sonora and Sinaloa the free road is mostly four lanes; south of Villa Unión it becomes a two-lane rural highway. Through Tepic it runs along Avenida Insurgentes, with some sections in tunnels beneath cross streets, and through Culiacán it has overpasses and controlled-access stretches.
zh: 特皮克至哈利斯科州界之间的峡谷地带是整条线路的工程难点。1923 至 1927 年间穿越同一地区的南太平洋铁路，在那里修建了 14 座高桥和 31 座隧道。公路从圣地亚哥河谷爬升进入林木茂密的山区，再下降到特皮克；再往东，免费公路从塞沃鲁科火山南侧经过，其中一段直接穿越火山熔岩区，而较新的收费公路则绕行火山北侧。
在索诺拉和锡那罗亚，免费公路大多为四车道；比亚乌尼翁以南则变为双车道乡村公路。穿过特皮克时，它沿起义者大道而行，部分路段以隧道从横街下方穿过；穿过库利亚坎时，则有立交桥和全封闭路段。

en: No construction cost for the route has been published. It was built over roughly two decades, in pieces, partly by state governments: in 1939 Arizona Highways reported that the governors of Sonora and Sinaloa had cut other spending and bought machinery in the United States to build their sections.

The modern spending is on the parallel toll road and on upkeep of the free one. The 237.84 km Tepic–Villa Unión toll road was concessioned on 6 April 2005 to Promotora Inbursa, part of Carlos Slim's financial group, which La Jornada reported would invest 1,612 million pesos. In January 2026 the federal government announced 8,659 million pesos to resurface 3,170 km of federal road in the north-west, including the México–Nogales corridor from Estación Don to Nogales and Highway 15 between Guaymas and Hermosillo.
zh: 这条线路没有公开的造价。它历时约二十年分段修成，其中一部分由州政府出资：1939 年《亚利桑那公路》报道，索诺拉和锡那罗亚两州州长削减其他开支，并从美国购置机械，修建本州路段。

如今的开支主要用于并行的收费公路以及免费公路的养护。237.84 公里的特皮克—比亚乌尼翁收费公路于 2005 年 4 月 6 日特许给卡洛斯·斯利姆旗下金融集团的 Promotora Inbursa 公司，据《每日报》报道，该公司将投资 16.12 亿比索。2026 年 1 月，联邦政府宣布投入 86.59 亿比索，对西北地区 3,170 公里联邦公路进行重铺，其中包括墨西哥—诺加莱斯走廊的埃斯塔西翁东至诺加莱斯段，以及瓜伊马斯至埃莫西约之间的 15 号公路。

en: The road is free throughout; the tolls are on 15D. Foreign-registered vehicles need a temporary import permit to go beyond Guaymas, and northbound drivers stop for agricultural inspection at Estación Don on the Sonora–Sinaloa line. In Mazatlán the highway is an ordinary city boulevard, Luis Donaldo Colosio, and in Morelia it passes the Plaza de Armas and the cathedral.

American enthusiasts once wanted it renumbered. Arizona Highways noted in 1955 that boosters of US Route 89, which then ended at Nogales, had petitioned the Mexican government to call the road 89 'to keep the number in the family'.
zh: 全线免费，收费的是 15D 号公路。外国牌照车辆驶过瓜伊马斯须办理临时进口许可；北行车辆须在索诺拉与锡那罗亚交界处的埃斯塔西翁东接受农产品检查。在马萨特兰，这条公路是一条普通的城市大道——路易斯·唐纳多·科洛西奥大道；在莫雷利亚，它从武器广场和主教座堂旁经过。
美国的爱好者曾希望给它改号。《亚利桑那公路》1955 年提到，当时止于诺加莱斯的美国 89 号公路的支持者曾向墨西哥政府请愿，要求把这条路编为 89 号，「让编号留在一家人里」。

value.en: 2,363.51 km, from the transport ministry's 2011 road data, as cited in English Wikipedia; Spanish Wikipedia gives 2,378 km, the sum of its state figures (Sonora 697, Sinaloa 641, Nayarit 254, Jalisco 240, Michoacán 426, State of Mexico 106, Mexico City 14)
value.zh: 2,363.51 公里，出自交通部 2011 年道路数据，据英语维基百科引述；西班牙语维基百科作 2,378 公里，为其各州数据之和（索诺拉 697、锡那罗亚 641、纳亚里特 254、哈利斯科 240、米却肯 426、墨西哥州 106、墨西哥城 14）

figures.source: SCT, Datos Viales 2011, as cited in English Wikipedia, Mexican Federal Highway 15; Spanish Wikipedia, Carretera Federal 15

value.en: Sources disagree: 1 September 1952 (Spanish Wikipedia, citing Miguel Alemán's government report); 1954, for construction from Guadalajara to Nogales begun in 1946 (Bryan, 1957); paved from Sinaloa to Nogales in 1950 (Arreola and Madsen, 1999)
value.zh: 各方说法不一：1952 年 9 月 1 日（西班牙语维基百科，援引米格尔·阿莱曼的政府报告）；1954 年，指 1946 年开工的瓜达拉哈拉至诺加莱斯段（布赖恩，1957）；锡那罗亚至诺加莱斯段 1950 年铺装（阿雷奥拉与马德森，1999）

figures.source: Spanish Wikipedia, Carretera Federal 15; William M. Bryan, A Geographic Study of the Tourist Industry of Mexico, MSc thesis, Oklahoma State University, 1957; Daniel D. Arreola and Kenneth D. Madsen, Variability of tourist attraction on an international boundary: Sonora, Mexico border towns, Visions in Leisure and Business, 1999

why.en: No public figure. The road was assembled over about two decades from sections built by the federal government and, in the 1930s, by state governments, and no source found totals them.
why.zh: 无公开数据。这条路历时约二十年，由联邦政府以及 1930 年代的州政府分段修建拼接而成，未找到任何汇总数字。

value.en: Federal and state governments. In 1939 the governors of Sonora and Sinaloa were reported to be cutting other budget items and buying machinery in the United States to build their sections. The road is now a toll-free federal highway maintained by SICT.
value.zh: 联邦与州政府。1939 年有报道称，索诺拉和锡那罗亚两州州长削减预算中的其他项目、从美国购置机械，修建本州路段。如今这条路是由基础设施、通信和交通部（SICT）养护的免费联邦公路。

figures.source: Don Smith, On the Road to Mexico, Arizona Highways, November 1939; English Wikipedia, Mexican Federal Highway 15

label.zh: 并行收费公路（特皮克—比亚乌尼翁）

value.en: 237.84 km of Highway 15D concessioned on 6 April 2005 to Promotora Inbursa, which La Jornada reported would invest 1,612 million pesos; the concession was later extended to April 2060
value.zh: 15D 号公路 237.84 公里，2005 年 4 月 6 日特许给 Promotora Inbursa，据《每日报》报道该公司将投资 16.12 亿比索；特许期后来延长至 2060 年 4 月

figures.source: Proyectos México, 0106 Carretera Tepic–Villa Unión; La Jornada, 2 March 2005

value.en: Travellers through Nogales into the interior rose from 38,000 in 1954 to 73,000 in 1959
value.zh: 经诺加莱斯进入内地的旅客从 1954 年的 38,000 人增至 1959 年的 73,000 人

figures.source: Daniel D. Arreola and Kenneth D. Madsen, Visions in Leisure and Business, 1999

value.en: 8,659 million pesos (2026) for 3,170 km of federal road in the north-west, including the Estación Don–Nogales corridor and Highway 15 between Guaymas and Hermosillo; the figure covers several roads, not Highway 15 alone
value.zh: 86.59 亿比索（2026 年），用于西北地区 3,170 公里联邦公路，包括埃斯塔西翁东—诺加莱斯走廊及瓜伊马斯至埃莫西约之间的 15 号公路；该数字涵盖多条道路，并非仅限 15 号公路

figures.source: Government of Sonora, Rehabilitan Durazo y Sheinbaum red carretera de Sonora, 21 January 2026

timeline.en: Arizona Highways reports the Mexico City–Guadalajara road paved and work under way between Guadalajara and the Nayarit boundary; cars can reach only Guaymas in comfort.
timeline.zh: 《亚利桑那公路》报道，墨西哥城至瓜达拉哈拉道路已铺装，瓜达拉哈拉至纳亚里特州界段正在施工；汽车只能舒适地开到瓜伊马斯。

timeline.en: The road south from Nogales is asphalted and called International Highway number 15, by a local history's account.
timeline.zh: 据一部地方史记载，诺加莱斯南出的道路铺上沥青，并被称为 15 号国际公路。

timeline.en: Construction begins from Guadalajara towards Nogales, according to Bryan's 1957 study.
timeline.zh: 据布赖恩 1957 年的研究，瓜达拉哈拉至诺加莱斯段开工。

timeline.en: The highway is paved between Sinaloa and Nogales, according to Arreola and Madsen.
timeline.zh: 据阿雷奥拉与马德森的研究，锡那罗亚至诺加莱斯段铺装完成。

timeline.en: The road is finished on 1 September under Miguel Alemán, according to Spanish Wikipedia.
timeline.zh: 据西班牙语维基百科，全线于 9 月 1 日在米格尔·阿莱曼任内完工。

timeline.en: Bryan gives this as the year the Guadalajara–Nogales section was completed.
timeline.zh: 布赖恩将这一年记为瓜达拉哈拉至诺加莱斯段完工之年。

timeline.en: Travellers through Nogales into the interior reach 73,000 a year, nearly double the 1954 figure.
timeline.zh: 经诺加莱斯进入内地的旅客达到每年 73,000 人，几乎是 1954 年的两倍。

timeline.en: The parallel Tepic–Villa Unión toll road is concessioned on 6 April.
timeline.zh: 4 月 6 日，并行的特皮克—比亚乌尼翁收费公路完成特许签约。

timeline.en: The national road programme for 2025–2030 lists México–Nogales as the first of fifteen trunk axes.
timeline.zh: 2025—2030 年全国公路计划将墨西哥—诺加莱斯列为十五条干线轴线中的第一条。

timeline.en: Resurfacing of the Estación Don–Nogales corridor, including Guaymas–Hermosillo, is announced in January.
timeline.zh: 1 月，埃斯塔西翁东—诺加莱斯走廊（含瓜伊马斯—埃莫西约段）重铺工程宣布实施。
